title: Define private ECR signer image and CodeBuild connectivity contracts
classification_reason: Terraform network and IAM security boundary
expected_outcome: Repository code requires a digest-pinned private ECR signer image, declares the approved STS and CloudWatch Logs private endpoints, and defines a least-privilege OIDC ECR mirror contract without any cloud activation.
constraints: Do not apply Terraform, access AWS, ECR, Vault, or EKS, publish images, alter secrets, or enable a deployed signer.
Do not add NAT, Internet gateway, static AWS credentials, or a public registry runtime dependency.

primary_owner.responsibility: supply-chain, IAM, and private-network security integration

acceptance_checks: map existing workflow, network, and signer contracts
delegations.escalation_trigger: live registry, IAM, endpoint, or secrets access is required
implementation would publish, assume an AWS role, or require an unapproved secret
